name: tilttek/game-engine
description: A generic state machine for online table games, initiative turns and the phases of a role-playing scene, without game rules: phases and transitions on Symfony Workflow, sequential, initiative, simultaneous or free turns, table options checked by the OptionsResolver, each table a log of moves with its seed and its state a cache rebuilt by replaying the log, deterministic chance, undo of a move that revealed nothing, optimistic concurrency, and a port to publish each change, through Mercure or otherwise
